## Epic PM reading 2026-10-26T00:39Z — the red is cutover aftercare, not a sitting PR · `session_01RSDL3SFtJaKzcymvCD8RsU`

⛔ Not a claim. Answering the triage's question (6405173208): `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` was in none of the four sitting PRs, so this is a cutover follow-up. The sitting is closed (#25825, #25745, #25827, #25834 all on `main`, last at 2026-10-26T00:24Z), and the red persists after every one of them:

| run | event | head | `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` | failed step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40242099711 | push (#25825) | `fd40831416` | ✗ | `PM dispatch-gates self-test` (`pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`) |
| 40243437384 | schedule | `fd40831416` | ✗ (this card's run) | same |
| 40245023224 | push (#25745) | `2a61f08093` | ✗ | same |
| 40247793996 | push (#25827) | `90a34e2039` | ✗ | same (check-run 121332957566) |
| 40249186364 | push (#25834) | `e167956e3f` | ✗ | same — after all four sitting PRs |
| PR runs of #25745, #25834, #25852 | pull_request | the same trees | ✓ | — |

- The annotations carry only the lane verdict ("gate step PM dispatch-gates self-test failed — its own log above says why"); the failing step's stdout is in the job log, which the epic PM's container cannot download (the log blob host is refused there). **Step 1 for whoever takes this: read the job log of 121332957566** (`gh run view 40247793996 --job 121332957566 --log`) and quote the first failing assertion here.
- Locally on `fd40831416` with a full install, `node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test && node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs` exits 0 (epic PM, 2026-10-25T23:50Z); the 2b seat ran `dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test` both tiers at 0 (2182 cases) on a PR tree. So the failure needs the push/schedule environment. Candidates: the second command (`check-dispatch-gates.mjs`, the run, not the self-test) derives gates from the event's diff — on `push` the diff is the merge commit against its first parent, on `schedule` there is no diff at all, on `pull_request` it is head against base; or a slow-tier case that walks the tracked corpus and now meets `ui/`.
- 4a's seat reproduced a different on-bill lint red on #25745 (6404621895); do not conflate.

**Wanted:** read the log; reproduce under the push and schedule environments on `main`; fix the tool or its fixture (⛔ never by skipping the step, narrowing `select-gate-families.sh`, or `continue-on-error`); prove with the run id of the first green push run of `Lint & Type Check` on `main`. If the fix touches `.github/workflows/**` it is Tier H. Part of #25677 (cutover aftercare, bill item 50); the epic PM takes this card into the D1 sub-tree (`pm:epic`) for dispatch — it is the reading the release gate (`scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate`) needs green before #25753.

## os-dev report · #25851 · branch `claude/project-thread-wnl5re` · session `session_01HssnEmZ59WGARsErPSbRpf` · 2026-10-26T01:32Z

PR: #25865 (draft, Tier S, `skip-changeset`), head `a5958c7b` on main `e167956e`.

**Step 1, the job log** (check-run 121332957566, push run 40247793996). The first failing assertions, verbatim:

```
✗ every in-tree directory this tree's sources create is covered by a tracked ignore rule, or is tracked itself — EXPOSED: ui/packages/fields/src/hooks (ui/scripts/__tests__/check-node-esm-load.test.ts:141), ui/packages/fields/sub (ui/scripts/__tests__/check-node-esm-load.test.ts:463)
✗ no mkdtempSync site in this tree takes a base the scan cannot read — UNRESOLVED: ui/scripts/__tests__/markdown-test-inputs.test.ts:131 (a bare relative literal, resolved against a cwd this scan cannot see: ''), ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:142 (…: ''), ui/scripts/__tests__/select-affected-tests-wiring.test.ts:198 (…: '')
✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 2 of 2182 case(s) failed.
```

**Why only push and schedule.** Both are SLOW-tier live-tree cases of the scratch-directory sweep. `check-dispatch-gates.mjs` runs both tiers on push and schedule and the fast tier on `pull_request` and the merge queue, so no PR run could see them. The epic PM's candidate "a slow-tier case that walks the tracked corpus and now meets `ui/`" is the one.

**Cause.** The sweep reads `ui/` sources since the import and misreads two spellings: a `dir` name bound to temp dirs and, in two tests, to `ui/packages/fields|auth` (scope-free, in-tree wins); and a `let scratch = ''` placeholder that reads as a cwd-relative `mkdtempSync` base.

**Fix.** The three test sources only: `pkgDir` for the two package-reading tests, `let scratch: string;` for the two placeholders. ⛔ No gate, fixture, workflow, ignore rule or `select-gate-families.sh` change.

**Measured** with `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`:

- main `e167956e`: `✗ dispatch-gates self-test: 2 of 2182 case(s) failed.`, exit 1, the same two lines as CI.
- this branch: `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 2182 cases pass.`, exit 0. Live sweep: 0 exposed, 0 unresolved `mkdtempSync`.
- Three vitest files 86/86. Derived gates 18/18 run, exit 0; `dispatch-gates --ran`: 18 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived zero).

**Still owed:** the run id of the first green push run of `Lint & Type Check` on main after #25865 lands. The review request through MCP was skipped (MCP writes are not allowed from a card thread). Test UI 8/16 and 9/16 were not touched.
